items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(e) and (f) cover the necessary initial survey and first attendance charge. Allow €180 gross for that scope, excluding pinpointing and measurements billed separately.
Section 7.1.7(e) covers the investigation needed to locate the under-sink leak. Allow €200 gross for one targeted pinpointing service, not a separate purchase charge for the contractor's equipment.

items.description: Kitchen floor and wall-base moisture measurement
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(e) covers measurement of the affected floor and wall base. Allow €95 gross for one survey of those areas.

Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(c) allow only necessary labour not already billed in the survey and testing lines. For this localized investigation, allow about 3 additional hours at €85 gross rather than the 14 claimed.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel, mileage or call-out charge on the invoice. Line 1 is the first attendance charge; €65 is the conditional value of a standalone van charge.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.1(b) cover the necessary access work for the failed interior supply pipe. Allow €130 gross for localized exposure.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged pipe insulation
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(a) covers removal and disposal of affected material. Allow €18 gross per piece for the two small insulation sections.

items.description: Repair copper pipe and restore standard insulation
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) and (g) cover the short copper replacement, fittings, standard insulation and installation labour. Allow €375 gross, excluding the access and disposal already billed separately.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) require evidence of insured moisture in the area dried, and the loss was confined to the kitchen. The €300 estimate is conditional on a supported small drying job.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary dryer hire for the affected kitchen. Allow €220 gross for one normal rental period, without duplicating the drying service below.

items.description: Dry kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b) covers drying the documented wet floor and wall base. Allow €355 gross for the drying service and labour apart from the separately billed dryer hire.
Section 7.1.8(c) bars duplicate costs across trades, and line 8 already covers the repaired pipe and its insulation. Allow €70 gross only if these are substantiated as distinct, necessary materials.

Section 7.1.8(a) excludes general cleaning, even within the work area; this line does not identify removal of loss or repair debris under 5.2.1. If it represents covered residue removal, allow €65 gross.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on the drying contractor's invoice. Allow €65 gross for one local trip.
Section 7.1.7(h) expressly covers removing the damaged furnishing from the dwelling. Allow €45 gross for carrying out one table, apart from haulage.

items.description: Transport and dispose of damaged table
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(h) and 5.2.1 cover haulage and disposal of the damaged table. Allow €60 gross for the two billed operations combined, excluding removal from the dwelling already billed in line 15.
The scheduled new-for-old option under 7.1.1(d) removes the age deduction, and the same model meets 7.1.9. The gross replacement price is €440 × 1.19 = €523.60 under 7.7.
Section 7.1.7(h) expressly covers delivery of the comparable replacement furnishing. Allow €50 gross for one local delivery.

items.description: Assemble table and clean installation spot
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) covers setting up the replacement and cleaning the spot where the damaged table stood. Allow €65 gross for basic assembly and spot cleaning, not general kitchen cleaning.
Section 7.1.7(f) permits the first vehicle charge on this contractor's invoice. Allow €50 gross for one local attendance, provided it is distinct from the delivery and haulage already billed.
Section 7.1.7(f) excludes the second vehicle charge on the same invoice, even if another visit was needed. The €50 figure is the conditional standalone trip value.

items.description: Inspect other furniture stored in the garden
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude inspection of items not established as affected by the kitchen leak. The €60 figure is conditional on a comparable inspection of affected furniture.
